versions.changelog:
Initial release of pizarra-explicativa-f100k: converts a talking head video into a hand-animated whiteboard summary for split screen.

- Turns a video (with .srt) into 8–12 "beats" mapped visually, using only the speaker's vocabulary (no generic/marketing language).
- Asks for user approval (via Telegram) and provides cost estimate before generating clips.
- Generates one whiteboard-style clip per beat using specific Higgsfield presets, reviews and regenerates if handwriting is distorted.
- Concatenates all clips into one pizarra.mp4 (no alpha, audio, or subtitles) for easy alignment in editors; delivers all assets and a LEEME with beat/time codes.
- Triggers only on specific requests (split screen, hand-annotation, etc.) and with a local video file; does not handle b-roll, editing, or YouTube overlays.
